description: Cross-language wire contract for cli.proto SchedulePayload. base64Std is the standard-base64 encoding of the protobuf bytes for `payload`. The TS test (packages/schedule) asserts encode(payload) === base64Std and decode round-trips; the Rust test (apps/cli) asserts it decodes the same bytes to the same fields. Both must stay in sync because they share this single fixture.
